FRI AUG 21 7:05 AM PT RUN.

TOAST -- Thursday Aug 20 loaded from the group nightly email (arrived 6:36 AM PT). Net $5,211.35, gross $5,377.85, discounts $166.50 (3.1% of gross), labor 20.6% of net (~$1,073.54), 189 guests, 130 orders, avg/order $40.09, avg/guest $27.57, 4 void items, 110 card payments, 1 order left open at close. Versus Thursday Aug 13 (net $4,563.25, gross $4,779.75, 202 guests, 126 orders, avg/guest $22.59): net +14.2%, gross +12.5%, guests -6.4%, orders +3.2%, spend per guest +22.0%. That is the shape you want -- slightly lighter traffic converting at a much higher check. It also reverses Wednesday's pattern exactly: Wed Aug 19 was more tickets at a much smaller average with a 9.8% discount rate; Thursday was fewer covers at a bigger average with a 3.1% discount rate. The Expresso Service over-comping flagged yesterday ($196.90 of discounts on a $396.75 line) did not recur at the day level. Labor at 20.6% is the best reading in the recent set. PARTIAL: the 229 W Montecito single-location summary (~7:38 AM PT) had not landed at 7:05, so checks, avg check, dayparts, revenue centers, sales categories and 4-week averages for Aug 20 are still missing and will backfill tomorrow. Wed Aug 19 remains the most recent fully-detailed day and is preserved in toastPrevDay / toastLastKnown.

SLING -- Friday Aug 21 roster delivered 7:00 AM PT and loaded live: 10 employees, 10 shifts, 55.25 scheduled hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime, 0 employees off. Kitchen covered by Isael Salvador Narciso. That is +54.5% scheduled hours versus Thursday's 35.75. Mix is 4 servers, 3 bartenders, 1 busser, 1 barista, 1 cook. At that hour count the day needs roughly $5,000+ net to keep hourly labor near Thursday's 20.6%.

GOOGLE ADS -- live dashboard scrape succeeded (343-687-4835, range set to Yesterday). Aug 20: 170 impressions, 15 clicks, 8.82% CTR, $22.98 cost, $1.53 avg CPC, 0 conversions. Day over day: impressions -58, clicks +4, cost +$5.38, CPC -$0.07, conversions -1. CTR nearly doubled off a smaller impression base. Cost overran the $15.00/day budget by 53%, which is within Google's normal overdelivery but worth knowing. Last 7 days (Aug 14-20): 7,433 impressions, 213 clicks, $394.03, 86 conversions, $1.85 avg CPC. CAMPAIGN STATE CONFIRMED ON SCREEN: only 'BHC Coffee | Search | P1 Launch' is Eligible. 'Local store visits and promotions-Performance Max-2' ($58.37/day) is PAUSED with all asset groups limited by policy AND limited by budget -- day 4 dark, and this is the main restaurant campaign. 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap' ($10.80/day) also paused on policy. 'World Cup HQ 2026' ($20.00/day) paused. 0 disapproval emails. NEW: an 'Add a backup payment method' warning is now showing in the account header -- not blocking delivery yet, but worth clearing.

YELP ADS -- MAJOR CHANGE: the login wall that blocked 13 consecutive runs since Aug 8 is GONE. Full live read. Last 30 days: ~40k ad impressions (78% of ~51.1k total), 369 ad clicks, 446 page visits from ads (58% of 764), 105 leads from ads (69% of 152). Billing period Aug 1-20: $262.67 ad spend, $1.06 avg CPC, $3.92 avg cost-per-lead. Trailing 12 months: 1,961 leads, 1,247 from ads (64%), 714 organic; breakdown is website visits 937 (48%), directions and map views 872 (44%), calls 127 (6%), CTA clicks 25 (1%). Against the last good read on Aug 7, 30-day ad leads dropped from 148 to 105 and ad page visits from 520 to 446 on roughly flat impressions, while cost-per-lead rose from $3.78 to $3.92 -- the ads are still being served but converting less efficiently. Bonus budget remaining could not be read: the Ad settings tab hung on loading skeletons. Also visible on the Yelp side: listing at 3.8 stars / 773 reviews, 15 unread Inbox items, 1 review badge. ACTION CLEARED -- Joal no longer needs to re-authenticate Yelp.

TRIPADVISOR -- no new business analytics email since the 4 AM run. The only item is the Aug 20 12:31 PM 'Your Ads are getting some MAJOR attention!' message already logged. Remaining TripAdvisor mail was consumer marketing. Nothing actionable.

REVIEWS -- not re-scraped this run; the 4 AM run live-verified both Google profiles. Carried forward: 2 unanswered 5-star reviews (sergio salazar on The Brewhouse, Geoff Lay on Brewhouse Coffee) with drafted replies still awaiting Joal's approval.
